He played [[college basketball]] for the [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|UConn Huskies]], winning two national championships. ==Early life and high school career== Clingan grew up in [[Bristol, Connecticut]] and attended [[Bristol Central High School]] where he led the boys basketball team to a 2020 Connecticut Interscholastic Athletic Conference Division II state championship.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28723706/donovan-clingan-contends-basketball-future-late-mother-memory|title=Donovan Clingan contends with basketball future, his late mother's memory|first=Charlotte|last=Gibson|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=May 8, 2020|access-date=March 22, 2023}}{{Cite news |last=Anthony |first=Mike |title=Donovan Clingan is the 7-foot-3 face of UConn basketball. He's still a small town CT kid at heart. |url=https://www.ctinsider.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/article/donovan-clingan-uconn-men-s-basketball-18424508.php |access-date=2024-05-17 |work=CT Insider |language=en}} He also played [[Amateur Athletic Union]] (AAU) basketball for [https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/39852638/2024-final-four-uconn-donovan-clingan-journey-dominance-marked-tragedy Joe Chatman] at Team Spartans in Dorchester, Massachusetts.{{Cite web |last=Courant |first=Hartford |date=April 21, 2021 |title=Bristol Central’s Donovan Clingan is back to dominating on the AAU circuit as college recruiting is set to ramp back up |url=https://www.courant.com/2021/04/21/bristol-centrals-donovan-clingan-is-back-to-dominating-on-the-aau-circuit-as-college-recruiting-is-set-to-ramp-back-up/ |access-date=March 23, 2024 |website=Hartford Courant |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |date=April 6, 2024 |title=UConn's Donovan Clingan and a journey of dominance marked by tragedy |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/39852638/2024-final-four-uconn-donovan-clingan-journey-dominance-marked-tragedy |access-date=April 21, 2024 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} Clingan averaged 27.3 points, 17.2 rebounds, and 5.8 blocks per game as a junior and was named the Connecticut Gatorade Player of the Year.{{cite web|url=https://www.ctpost.com/sports/article/Bristol-Central-s-Donovan-Clingan-Gatorade-16224029.php|title=Bristol Central's Donovan Clingan Gatorade State Player of Year, 1 of 3 finalists for national award|work=[[Connecticut Post]]|date=June 4, 2021|access-date=March 22, 2023}} Clingan repeated as the Connecticut Gatorade Player of the Year after averaging 30.3 points, 18.4 rebounds, and 6.2 blocks per game during his senior season.{{cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2023/03/21/sports/ncaabasketball/march-madness-uconn-clingan.html|title=UConn's Freshman Center Stands Out Off the Bench|first=Adam|last=Zagoria|work=[[The New York Times]]|date=March 22, 2023|access-date=March 22, 2023}} On July 2, 2021, he committed to playing college basketball for [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|UConn]] over offers from [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]], [[Michigan State Spartans men's basketball|Michigan State]], [[Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball|Ohio State]], [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown]], [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]], [[Providence Friars men's basketball|Providence]], and [[Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball|Rutgers]].{{cite web|url=https://www.theday.com/uconn-mens-basketball/20210702/bristol-central-center-donovan-clingan-commits-to-uconn/|title=Bristol Central center Donovan Clingan commits to UConn|work=[[The Day (New London)|The Day]]|date=July 2, 2021|access-date=March 22, 2023}} Clingan grew up and is close friends with current [[UConn Huskies football]] running back Victor Rosa. Rosa was Clingan's point guard in high school, and was a record-breaking football player as well.{{cite web|url=https://www.ctinsider.com/connecticutmagazine/news-people/article/donovan-clingan-uconn-men-s-basketball-18424508.php |title=The new face of UConn basketball is a 7-foot-3 phenom from CT |date=October 25, 2023 }} ==College career== Clingan entered his freshman season at UConn as the Huskies' backup center behind [[Adama Sanogo]].{{cite web|url=https://www.journalinquirer.com/sports/college/uconn_mens_basketball/uconn-notebook-clingan-makes-big-first-impression/article_db3d6470-5f46-11ed-8c74-9f305d4c3166.html|title=UConn Notebook: Clingan makes big first impression|first=Adam|last=Betz|work=[[Journal Inquirer]]|date=November 8, 2022|access-date=March 22, 2023}} He was named to the [[Big East Conference]] All-Freshman team at the end of the regular season.{{cite web|url=https://www.courant.com/2023/03/05/uconns-adama-sanogo-jordan-hawkins-named-first-team-all-big-east-karaban-clingan-on-all-freshman-team|title=UConn's Adama Sanogo, Jordan Hawkins named First Team All-Big East; Karaban, Clingan on All-Freshman team|first=Joe|last=Arruda|work=[[Hartford Courant]]|date=March 5, 2023|access-date=March 22, 2023}} Clingan scored four points with three rebounds, a block, and two steals in the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball championship game|2023 national championship game]] as the Huskies won 76–59.{{cite web|url=https://www.stamfordadvocate.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/article/donovan-clingan-national-championship-dan-hurley-17877175.php|title=Donovan Clingan makes good on promise, helps UConn men's basketball team 'get No. 5'|work=[[Stamford Advocate]]|date=April 4, 2023|access-date=April 4, 2023}} Although he was considered to be a likely selection in the [[2023 NBA draft]], he decided to return to UConn for his sophomore season.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/36121847/uconn-center-donovan-clingan-return-sophomore-season|title=UConn center Donovan Clingan to return for sophomore season|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=April 8, 2023|access-date=April 10, 2023}} Clingan entered his sophomore year as UConn's starting center.{{cite web|url=https://www.ctinsider.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/article/donovan-clingan-huskies-start-18472906.php|title=Donovan Clingan reflects on first start for UConn men's basketball team: 'Dream come true'|first=David|last=Borges|website=CT Insider|date=November 7, 2023|access-date=November 13, 2023}}{{cite web|url=https://www.courant.com/2023/11/04/uconn-mens-preview-donovan-clingan-the-huskies-ultimate-big-man-out-to-prove-hes-ready-for-the-big-time/|title=UConn men's preview: Donovan Clingan, the Huskies' ultimate big man, out to prove he's ready for the big time|work=[[Hartford Courant]]|date=November 4, 2023|access-date=November 13, 2023}} He suffered a foot injury in a game against Seton Hall on December 20, 2023.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/39173855/uconn-center-donovan-clingan-3-4-weeks-foot-injury|title=UConn center Donovan Clingan out 3-4 weeks with foot injury|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=December 23, 2023|access-date=April 10, 2024}} Clingan returned on January 17, 2024, scoring six points and grabbing five rebounds in 16 minutes of play in a 62–48 win over 18th-ranked Creighton.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/39332658/clingan-returns-injury-help-no-1-uconn-stop-creighton|title=Clingan returns from injury to help No. 1 UConn stop Creighton|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=January 17, 2024|access-date=April 10, 2024}} On April 12, 2024, Clingan declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]], forgoing his remaining college eligibility.{{cite web|author=Adrian Wojnarowski|title=UConn center Donovan Clingan entering NBA draft| url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/39929419/uconn-center-donovan-clingan-entering-nba-draft|website=ESPN.com|date=April 12, 2024|access-date= April 12, 2024}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player ==Personal life== Clingan's mother, Stacey Clingan, also played basketball at Bristol Central where she set school records for career rebounds and blocks before playing college basketball at the [[University of Maine]].{{cite web|url=https://theathletic.com/4332941/2023/03/22/uconn-donovan-clingan-sweet-16/|title=Donovan Clingan is UConn's next big star. His mom would have loved it|first=Dana|last=O'Neil|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=March 22, 2023|access-date=March 22, 2023}} Stacey Clingan died of breast cancer in March 2018.{{cite web|url=https://www.stamfordadvocate.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/final-four/article/final-four-donovan-clingan-houston-huskies-17872157.php|title=UConn men's basketball freshman Donovan Clingan honoring late mother at Final Four: "Make her proud'|work=[[Stamford Advocate]]|date=April 1, 2023|access-date=April 3, 2023}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://uconnhuskies.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/donovan-clingan/13276 UConn Huskies bio] {{2023 UConn Huskies men's basketball navbox}} {{2024 UConn Huskies men's basketball navbox}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Clingan, Donovan}} [[Category:2004 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Connecticut]] [[Category:Centers (basketball)]] [[Category:People from Bristol, Connecticut]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Hartford County, Connecticut]] [[Category:UConn Huskies men's basketball players]]
